content: Phase 5b plan submitted: docs/phases/phase-5b-dashboard-ux.md. Turns the Phase-5 minimal dashboard into a real operator UI. Design spine: unmistakable local-vs-cloud tier identity (local = free/emerald, cloud = paid/violet, per Aegis Control Room design language from ~/projects/QA) and visible already-scanned state so re-scans are deliberate. Scope: 5b.1 design system + tier chips/scan-state, 5b.2 readable results (formatted triage + clarification questions, colorized diffs, needs-attention split, run-history timeline from existing analyses rows), 5b.3 ops visibility (health LEDs, client-side filters, terminal collapse), 5b.4 project management UI + bug submission form + retry-only-when-failed. Backend deliberately minimal (analyses table already has provider/model/tokens/cost). Static split to index.html/styles.css/app.js, zero-build. Two impl cycles: 5b.1+5b.2 then 5b.3+5b.4. Non-goals: auto-fix acceptance (future), Phase 6 ingestion, websockets. Roadmap updated (Phase 5 marked complete, 5b inserted).

Request changes before implementation.

The UX scope is directionally acceptable, but the file-layout section is currently wrong for this repository and could break the packaged dashboard route if implemented literally.

Required amendment:
- Replace the planned `static/index.html` / `static/styles.css` / `static/app.js` paths with the actual package asset location: `src/bugalizer/static/index.html`, `src/bugalizer/static/styles.css`, and `src/bugalizer/static/app.js` (or explicitly state any retained `dashboard.html` shell if that is the chosen compatibility path).
- Update `src/bugalizer/main.py` serving behavior in the plan: `/` currently returns `_STATIC_DIR / "dashboard.html"`; after the split, the implementation must either serve `index.html` at `/` or keep `dashboard.html` as the entry point and load the split CSS/JS assets from the packaged static directory.
- Add explicit acceptance/tests for the split static assets: `GET /` still returns the dashboard unauthenticated, linked CSS/JS resolve under the deployed app, and package data still includes the split assets via the existing `bugalizer = ["static/*"]` glob.

Context: the current app serves assets from `src/bugalizer/static`, not a top-level `static/` directory. The current dashboard test only asserts that `/` returns HTML containing `Bugalizer` and `X-API-Key`; it will not catch broken CSS/JS links after the split unless the plan calls for that coverage.

After that amendment, the rest of the plan is acceptable: the two-cycle split is sensible, backend changes are appropriately minimal, and the plan already calls out the important API audit for per-tier scan summaries rather than assuming the current `localized` boolean is enough.

Round-1 feedback addressed — the File layout section is rewritten with the repository's actual asset location and an explicit serving + testing contract:

1. Paths corrected to package assets: src/bugalizer/static/index.html (replaces dashboard.html, removed) + src/bugalizer/static/styles.css + src/bugalizer/static/app.js. No top-level static/ directory.

2. main.py serving behavior specified: "/" serves _STATIC_DIR/"index.html" via the same unauthenticated FileResponse pattern; a new StaticFiles mount at /static serves the CSS/JS (there is currently no static mount at all — the plan now says so explicitly). index.html references /static/styles.css and /static/app.js by absolute path so links resolve behind the Caddy proxy. Packaging: existing bugalizer = ["static/*"] glob covers the new flat files; impl verifies via built-wheel/sdist file list.

3. Acceptance tests added (plan §File layout + success criterion 7): GET / → 200 HTML unauthenticated referencing both /static assets; every /static href/src in the served HTML is fetched and must return 200 with the expected content type (link-integrity check the current Bugalizer/X-API-Key assertion cannot provide); assets served from the installed-package _STATIC_DIR so Docker/NSSM deploys keep working.

No other plan changes. See docs/phases/phase-5b-dashboard-ux.md, section "File layout & serving (amended per review, round 1)".

Approved. Round-2 plan resolves the file-layout blocker: assets are now explicitly split under src/bugalizer/static, / serves index.html, CSS/JS are served through a /static mount from the packaged _STATIC_DIR, and acceptance tests cover / plus linked static assets and package-data deployment. The remaining UX/backend scope is appropriately bounded for the two implementation cycles.
